title: LFS04: Common tensor operations
body:
# LFS04 · Common tensor operations

对应《从零开始构建大模型》**附录 A · A.2.3 Common PyTorch tensor operations**（原创练习提纲，非书中原文）。

## 目标
- 练习 `reshape` / `view`、转置、矩阵乘、广播
- 知道 `view` 要求内存连续，必要时 `.contiguous()`

## 自检
- [ ] 改形状再 matmul，不报错

starterFiles.lfs04_main.py:
import torch

x = torch.arange(6)
print("x", x)
print("reshape (2,3)", x.reshape(2, 3))
print("view (3,2)", x.view(3, 2))

a = torch.tensor([[1.0, 2.0], [3.0, 4.0]])
b = torch.tensor([[5.0, 6.0], [7.0, 8.0]])
print("a @ b\n", a @ b)
print("a.T\n", a.T)

# broadcasting
v = torch.tensor([10.0, 20.0])
print("a + v\n", a + v)
